focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：出口管制与关税博弈并行，供应链合规压力持续上升
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸领域呈现两条主线：一是部分经济体继续收紧关键技术出口管制，半导体、人工智能及先进制造相关物项成为焦点，跨国企业面临更复杂的许可与尽职调查要求；二是关税与贸易救济措施仍在调整，部分行业面临反倾销、反补贴调查及原产地规则收紧。整体趋势显示，地缘政治因素正加速嵌入商业决策，出海企业需将合规审查前置到采购、研发与销售全流程，并动态评估供应链替代方案。
focus.source: 来源：综合主要经济体贸易主管部门及国际主流媒体 · 本周
focus.title_en: Weekly Global Trade Focus: Export Controls and Tariff Frictions Persist, Supply Chain Compliance Pressure Mounts
focus.summary_en: This week, international trade was marked by two main trends. First, several economies continued to tighten export controls on critical technologies, with semiconductors, artificial intelligence and advanced manufacturing items in focus, imposing more complex licensing and due diligence requirements on multinationals. Second, tariffs and trade remedies remained in flux, with anti-dumping and countervailing investigations and stricter rules of origin affecting certain sectors. The overall trend shows geopolitics is increasingly embedded in commercial decisions, requiring outbound Chinese enterprises to front-load compliance reviews across procurement, R&D and sales, and to dynamically assess supply chain alternatives.
focus.source_en: Source: Compiled from major economies' trade authorities and international media · this week

case.title: 本周跨境仲裁观察：国际货物买卖合同争议中不可抗力与情势变更的认定边界
case.summary: 本周一则国际商事仲裁案例受到关注，涉及因供应链中断导致的交货延迟，买方主张解除合同并索赔，卖方以不可抗力及情势变更为由抗辩。仲裁庭认为，单纯的成本上升或履约困难通常不构成不可抗力，除非合同明确约定或符合适用法律严格条件；同时，当事人未及时通知和减损可能影响责任分担。该案提示出海企业应在合同中细化不可抗力条款、通知义务与替代履行机制，并保留完整履约与沟通证据。
case.source: 来源：国际商事仲裁机构近期裁决综述 · 本周
case.title_en: Cross-Border Arbitration Watch: Boundaries of Force Majeure and Changed Circumstances in International Sales Disputes
case.summary_en: An international commercial arbitration case drew attention this week involving delayed delivery due to supply chain disruption. The buyer sought contract termination and damages, while the seller invoked force majeure and changed circumstances. The tribunal held that mere cost increases or performance difficulties generally do not constitute force majeure unless expressly agreed or strictly meeting applicable legal conditions; meanwhile, failure to give timely notice and mitigate may affect liability allocation. This case reminds outbound enterprises to refine force majeure clauses, notice obligations and alternative performance mechanisms in contracts, and to preserve complete performance and communication evidence.
case.source_en: Source: Review of recent awards by international commercial arbitration institutions · this week

policy.title: 本周中国涉外政策要点：粤港澳大湾区跨境规则衔接与贸易便利化持续深化
policy.summary: 本周中国涉外及跨境政策延续开放与便利化导向。粤港澳大湾区在跨境数据流动、职业资格互认、跨境商事纠纷解决等方面继续推进规则衔接，部分措施聚焦于提升企业跨境经营效率。同时，海关与贸易主管部门在通关一体化、原产地证书电子化及出口退税便利化方面出台细化安排，旨在降低合规成本。整体看，政策在鼓励出海的同时，也强化了出口管制、数据合规与反制裁合规要求，企业需同步关注合规义务。
policy.source: 来源：中国相关部委及粤港澳大湾区地方政府发布 · 本周
policy.title_en: China's Foreign-Related Policy Highlights: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Rule Alignment and Trade Facilitation Deepen
policy.summary_en: This week, China's foreign-related and cross-border policies continued to follow an opening-up and facilitation orientation. The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area advanced rule alignment in cross-border data flows, mutual recognition of professional qualifications and cross-border commercial dispute resolution, with some measures focusing on enhancing cross-border operational efficiency. Meanwhile, customs and trade authorities issued detailed arrangements on integrated customs clearance, electronic certificates of origin and export tax rebate facilitation, aiming to reduce compliance costs. Overall, while encouraging outbound business, policies also strengthened export control, data compliance and anti-sanctions requirements, requiring enterprises to monitor compliance obligations in tandem.
policy.source_en: Source: Released by relevant Chinese ministries and Greater Bay Area local governments · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应强化合规前置与合同弹性，关注下周管制清单动态
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周趋势表明，出口管制与关税政策仍处于高频调整期，企业不能仅依赖事后应对。建议出海企业：第一，建立跨部门合规小组，将出口管制、经济制裁、数据跨境与反商业贿赂审查嵌入交易全流程；第二，在合同中加入动态合规条款、价格调整机制与争议解决分层设计，预留政策变动下的退出与再谈判空间；第三，对关键供应商与客户开展分级尽职调查，并保留完整记录。下周应重点关注主要经济体管制清单更新、关税复审及大湾区跨境数据细则的后续落地。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周研判
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Outbound Enterprises Should Strengthen Front-Loaded Compliance and Contractual Flexibility, Watch Next Week's Control List Updates
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's trends show that export controls and tariff policies remain in a period of high-frequency adjustment, and enterprises cannot rely solely on after-the-fact responses. Outbound enterprises are advised to: first, establish a cross-departmental compliance team integrating export control, economic sanctions, cross-border data and anti-bribery reviews into the entire transaction process; second, incorporate dynamic compliance clauses, price adjustment mechanisms and tiered dispute resolution designs into contracts to reserve exit and renegotiation space amid policy changes; third, conduct tiered due diligence on key suppliers and customers and keep complete records. Next week, focus on updates to major economies' control lists, tariff reviews and the follow-up implementation of Greater Bay Area cross-border data rules.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · weekly view
